Game Overview

In SokoMatch, the core idea is straightforward: dive into SokoMatch's vibrant 3D world, where strategic moves are key. Push animal blocks to match and clear them, navigating ice and directional tiles in increasingly complex levels. Each strategic move challenges your wit, offering endless puzzle fun and brain-teasing delight. Can you clear all blocks in record moves?
